derivation: Three equal nonzero coplanar forces summing to zero give pairwise dot product -1/2 after normalization, hence 120°. Their head-to-tail triangle is equilateral with interior 60°. For three equilateral pins at radius r, the central network length is 3r versus two sides 2sqrt(3)r. Sum-of-distances is convex and its zero gradient at the center proves this junction minimizes that sum.
limitations: Equal tension, straight branches and fixed plate separation are idealizations. Arbitrary physical film states need not be global minima.
